parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM operacao o
        WHERE o.mailing_id = m.id
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM incorporadoras i
        JOIN operacao o2 ON o2.cnpj_digits = i.cnpj_digits
        WHERE i.id = m.idincorporadora
          AND i.cnpj_digits IS NOT NULL
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM operacao o3
        WHERE o3.cnpj_digits = m.cnpj_empresa
          AND m.cnpj_empresa IS NOT NULL
          AND m.cnpj_empresa <> ''
      )
      THEN 'Sim'
      ELSE 'Não'
    END AS tem_operacao
  FROM mailing m
) AS mailing_com_operacao
WHERE
  lixeira = 0
  AND tem_operacao = 'Não'
  AND fup IS NOT NULL
  AND fup <> ''
  AND DATE(fup) < CURDATE()
  AND whatsapp IS NOT NULL
  AND whatsapp <> ''
  AND (
    status_plano_acao IS NULL
    OR status_plano_acao = ''
    OR status_plano_acao NOT IN (
      'ptentativaderreativaçãor',
      'stentativadereativaçãor',
      'ttentativadereativaçãor',
      'encaminhar advisor',
      'naoeoICP'
    )
  )
ORDER BY DATE(fup) ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  c1.canonical_phone,
  c1.id AS id_1, c1.clientes AS cliente_1, c1.empresa AS empresa_1, c1.whatsapp AS whatsapp_1, c1.dono_do_lead AS dono_1, c1.fup AS fup_1, c1.status_plano_acao AS status_1,
  c2.id AS id_2, c2.clientes AS cliente_2, c2.empresa AS empresa_2, c2.whatsapp AS whatsapp_2, c2.dono_do_lead AS dono_2, c2.fup AS fup_2, c2.status_plano_acao AS status_2
FROM (
  SELECT
    id, clientes, empresa, whatsapp, dono_do_lead, fup, status_plano_acao, digits,
    CASE
      WHEN LENGTH(digits) = 11 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(digits, 2), SUBSTRING(digits, 4))
      WHEN LENGTH(digits) = 10 THEN digits
      ELSE digits
    END AS canonical_phone
  FROM (
    SELECT
      id, clientes, empresa, whatsapp, dono_do_lead, fup, status_plano_acao,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
        whatsapp, '(', ''), ')', ''), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '.', ''), '+', '') AS digits
    FROM mailing
    WHERE
      lixeira = 0
      AND whatsapp IS NOT NULL
      AND whatsapp <> ''
  ) normalized
  WHERE LENGTH(digits) IN (10, 11)
) c1
JOIN (
  SELECT
    id, clientes, empresa, whatsapp, dono_do_lead, fup, status_plano_acao, digits,
    CASE
      WHEN LENGTH(digits) = 11 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(digits, 2), SUBSTRING(digits, 4))
      WHEN LENGTH(digits) = 10 THEN digits
      ELSE digits
    END AS canonical_phone
  FROM (
    SELECT
      id, clientes, empresa, whatsapp, dono_do_lead, fup, status_plano_acao,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
        whatsapp, '(', ''), ')', ''), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '.', ''), '+', '') AS digits
    FROM mailing
    WHERE
      lixeira = 0
      AND whatsapp IS NOT NULL
      AND whatsapp <> ''
  ) normalized2
  WHERE LENGTH(digits) IN (10, 11)
) c2
  ON c1.canonical_phone = c2.canonical_phone
  AND c1.id < c2.id
ORDER BY c1.canonical_phone, c1.id;

SELECT
  m.id AS mailing_id,
  m.idincorporadora,
  i.cnpj_digits AS incorp_cnpj_digits,
  o.id AS operacao_id,
  o.cnpj_digits AS operacao_cnpj_digits,
  o.status,
  o.datacriacao

LEFT JOIN incorporadoras i ON i.id = m.idincorporadora
